tasks.title: SwiftData Connection & pairing models
acceptance_criteria: Connection entity models two paired users with stable identifiers
Schema supports one active Connection per pairing

tasks.title: Pairing via join link / deep link handling
acceptance_criteria: Join link generates a unique, resolvable pairing token
Opening the link on a second device links to the same Connection

tasks.title: SwiftData Card/Prompt/Answer models
acceptance_criteria: Card references a Prompt and up to two Answers (mine/theirs)
Model supports the awaitingBoth/awaitingMe/awaitingThem/complete states

tasks.title: Bundled 60-day prompt list content & indexing
acceptance_criteria: 60 distinct prompts ship in the bundle
Catalog exposes lookup by day index

tasks.title: App navigation shell
acceptance_criteria: Tabs for Today, Timeline, Compose, Settings are reachable
Selected tab persists across launches

tasks.title: LocalSyncService protocol definition
acceptance_criteria: Protocol exposes submitAnswer, observePartnerAnswer, and connection-state hooks
No concrete implementation is hardcoded into consumers; all access goes through the protocol

tasks.title: Timer-driven simulated partner implementation
acceptance_criteria: Implements LocalSyncService with a real Timer-driven delay before delivering the partner's answer
Never returns a pre-completed/hardcoded fixture as the partner answer

tasks.title: Card view UI for gated-reveal states
acceptance_criteria: Renders distinct visuals for awaitingBoth, awaitingMe, awaitingThem, and complete
State changes reflect immediately when the underlying Card updates

tasks.title: Answer sheet UI
acceptance_criteria: User can type and submit an answer for the current day's card
Draft text is held in view state before submission

tasks.title: Reveal UI for completed cards
acceptance_criteria: Both answers are displayed side by side once a card is complete
Reveal is only reachable once both answers exist

tasks.title: Tether+ entitlement & StoreKit purchase flow
acceptance_criteria: User can purchase/restore Tether+ via StoreKit
Entitlement state is queryable synchronously by feature-gated views

tasks.title: Paywall gating framework
acceptance_criteria: Single reusable gate checks entitlement before exposing a premium action
Non-entitled users see a consistent paywall prompt

tasks.title: Daily prompt local notifications
acceptance_criteria: A local notification is scheduled once per canonical day for the active prompt
Rescheduling on relaunch does not duplicate pending notifications

tasks.title: Daily card creation/scheduling logic
acceptance_criteria: Exactly one Card is created per Connection per canonical day
Re-launching the app never creates a duplicate Card for the same day

tasks.title: Compose & Share skin enum architecture
acceptance_criteria: Skin is modeled as an enum/protocol extension point with only 'classic indigo' populated
Adding a new skin requires no changes to call sites, only a new case/conformance

tasks.title: Answer submission: haptic tick + state transition
acceptance_criteria: Submitting an answer fires a crisp .rigid tick haptic
Card moves to awaitingThem, or to complete if the partner already answered

tasks.title: Answer submission save-failure retry/error state
acceptance_criteria: If the SwiftData save fails, the Answer sheet keeps the typed draft visible
An explicit retry/error UI is shown instead of silently discarding input or crashing

tasks.title: Answer finality & uneditable lock UI
acceptance_criteria: Once both answers exist, both become permanently uneditable
A visible 'sealed/final' indicator appears at the moment of submission completion, not just later

tasks.title: Canonical UTC day boundary utility
acceptance_criteria: Day boundary is computed once at the Connection level using UTC, not either user's local calendar day
All card 'today' and streak logic reads from this single utility

tasks.title: Gated-reveal state machine
acceptance_criteria: States are exactly awaitingBoth -> awaitingThem/awaitingMe -> complete, no additional states
Machine drives all transitions through the LocalSyncService protocol
Simulated partner transitions arrive via the timer-driven service, never a pre-completed fixture

tasks.title: Seeded-fixture tests for state machine edge cases
acceptance_criteria: Deterministic seeded test covers simultaneous both-answer-same-tick
Deterministic seeded test covers simulated partner's timer firing while app is backgrounded mid-submission
Deterministic seeded test covers simulated partner's timer firing while the Answer sheet is open with an uncommitted draft, asserting the open draft is untouched and not lost

tasks.title: Heartbeat haptic on foregrounded partner answer
acceptance_criteria: A two-beat .soft haptic ~140ms apart fires when the partner's answer lands while app is foregrounded
Test explicitly documents this is not required/tested for backgrounded delivery

tasks.title: Completion success haptic + tether snap animation
acceptance_criteria: A success notification haptic fires on card completion
Tether visual snaps taut in sync with the crisp tick

tasks.title: Streak computation: personal vs shared
acceptance_criteria: Personal answer streak counts consecutive canonical days the user answered
Shared completion streak counts consecutive canonical days both answers completed the card
Both values are independently queryable

tasks.title: Streak UI: personal vs shared display
acceptance_criteria: Personal answer streak and shared completion streak are shown as visually distinct values
No merged/ambiguous single streak number is shown

tasks.title: Streak break attribution UI
acceptance_criteria: When the completion streak breaks, UI legibly states whether the user or the partner failed to answer
Attribution is correct for both single-sided and mutual misses

tasks.title: Missed-day streak reset + visible surfacing
acceptance_criteria: A missed canonical UTC day resets the completion streak to 0 the following day
The reset is visibly surfaced in the UI, not just silently applied

tasks.title: Prompt wraparound with 'answered before' badge
acceptance_criteria: After the 60-day list is exhausted, prompts repeat starting from day 1
A visible 'you've answered this before' badge appears on repeated prompts

tasks.title: Timeline of completed cards
acceptance_criteria: Every completed card appears in a vertical Timeline in chronological order
Tapping a past card lets the user relive it and re-share it

tasks.title: Compose & Share base PNG export
acceptance_criteria: User can pick the classic indigo skin, preview the result, and export a static PNG
Exported PNG is watermarked with the join link
Base static export has no paywall for any user

tasks.title: Animated export toggle & paywall gating
acceptance_criteria: Animated-export toggle is visible to all users
Free users see correct paywall gating when enabling it
Entitled Tether+ users see an explicit 'coming soon' state, with no crash, silent no-op, or fake file produced
